BL-1101 — A hand-authored mutation sweep certifies mutants it never ran: expedite_mutation_sweep.sh's only failure branch reads the survivor list, so a stale anchor skips silently while the run prints ALL MUTANTS KILLED and exits 0
What it solves: Filed by the specifier 2026-08-23 while accepting the hardender's rule_proposal of the same date (appended to swarmforge/roles/hardender.prompt). The rule generalizes to any sweep hand-authored fresh under the BL-638 / no-wired-tool fallback; this ticket hardens the one committed script, because a …
Approval context: One decision needs sign-off: whether a skipped mutant HARD-FAILS the sweep (the direction below - non-zero exit, no success line) or merely prints a louder warning while the run still passes. The argument for hard failure is that a skipped mutant produced no evidence at all, so a run containing one…
